 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case instituted for the offence under Sections 498A,
304B, 201/34 of the Indian Penal Code 3
As per prosecution case, it is a case of dowry death due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry of Rs. 2 lakhs of the deceased by the petitioner along with other.
4. It is submitted on behalf fo the petitioner that he has been falsely implicated in this case.

He further submitted that during the course of the investigation on 30.07.2019 the dead body of Samta Devi was recovered from Berkula Ghat and thereafter the post- mortem of the dead body of Samta Devi was held on 30.07.2019 at Sadar Hospital, Khagaria by a Medical Board but the cause of death of the deceased was found due to throttling producing Asphyxia and Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.18209 of 2023(5) dt.19-09-2023 leading to C.R. failure.

It is further submitted that medical evidence does not support the aforesaid allegation that aforesaid accused persons including the petitioner were seen by the informant that they were throwing the deceased and her daughter in water and deceased Samta Devi was raising alarm for help in as much as the post- mortem report does not show that she died due to drowning.

5. The application for bail is opposed by learned APP for the State and submitted that there is specific case of the prosecution that the petitioner who is husband of the deceased committed murdered of the deceased during investigation witnesses supported the prosecution case and doctor has opined that death due to acute severe pencratitis with respiratory failure.

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this court is not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Therefore, the prayer for bail of this petitioner is rejected.
7. However, the trial Court Court is directed for speedy trial of the case within a year.

(Sunil Kumar Panwar, J) sanjeev/-
